entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Please be aware that this call may be recorded for quality assurance. Your call will be answered in the order it was received.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I bought a jersey from you people over two months ago and it's completely useless. I want to return it. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
The name is Arthur Pendelton, and the order number is... VF77801. Look, I don't have time for a runaround. This is ridiculous. The jersey is the wrong size, and I want my money back.

Thank you for that information, Mr. Pendelton. I see your order here. To make sure I understand correctly, is the issue with the jersey a technical fault, or is it more of a preference issue with the fit?

What kind of a question is that? It doesn't fit! It's way too tight in the shoulders. I ordered a Large, and this feels like a Medium. I want to exchange it or get a refund. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand your frustration, and I can definitely help you with this. There's no need to speak to a manager. Let me just review the return policy for your item.
You'd better. Because if I don't get this sorted, I'll be leaving reviews on every single cycling forum about this. This is supposed to be premium gear.

Okay, Mr. Pendelton, I've just checked the policy. It looks like your jersey was delivered 73 days ago, and our standard items have a 90-day return window. You are well within the timeframe. I can process this return for you immediately.
Well, it's about time. So what's next? Are you sending me a label?

Yes, absolutely. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now, and it will be in your email inbox within the next five minutes. You can either opt for a full refund back to your original payment method, or we can process an exchange for a different size.
Fine. An exchange for an XL would work. Just make sure it's the right one this time.

Of course. I've put in the exchange order now for the jersey in a size XL. And Mr. Pendelton, I see you're one of our VIP customers. To apologize for the sizing issue and the frustration this has caused, I've gone ahead and upgraded the shipping on your new jersey to complimentary next-day air. You should receive it the day after you drop the original one off at the post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Oh. Next-day air? Okay, that's better. That's good service. No, that's all. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
